 The weekend back-to-back is in the books. Let's assess. Zach Weiss | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source Nov 4, 2026; Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, USA; Cleveland Cavaliers forward Mario Hezonja (33) walks across the court after a play against the Oklahoma City Thunder during the first half at Paycom Center. Mandatory Credit: Alonzo Adams-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect In this story:
 Cleveland Cavaliers The Cavs entered Saturday night off a big win over the Sixers . The Knicks were waiting in the wings on the tail end of a competitive back-to-back, and they didn’t seem prepared. 
--> The Cavs entered Saturday night off a big win over the Sixers . The Knicks were waiting in the wings on the tail end of a competitive back-to-back, and they didn’t seem prepared. 
 New York started to blitz by the end of the first half, and it was clear that the short-handed Cleveland team was not prepared for what was being tossed at them. Of course, over the course of the 48 minutes, they did show some good signs. 
--> New York started to blitz by the end of the first half, and it was clear that the short-handed Cleveland team was not prepared for what was being tossed at them. Of course, over the course of the 48 minutes, they did show some good signs. 
 But all in all, it does not seem like a playoff series that the Cavs would be ready for if it happened today. Same old issues. Here are the two players that surprised me most from the battle, both positively and negatively. Spoiler: They did not treat this like a major game. 
--> But all in all, it does not seem like a playoff series that the Cavs would be ready for if it happened today. Same old issues. Here are the two players that surprised me most from the battle, both positively and negatively. Spoiler: They did not treat this like a major game. 
 1) James Harden: Struggling Significantly
--> 1) James Harden: Struggling Significantly
 Trying to find anything James Harden did correctly against the Knicks was a challenge. He wasn’t making shots, scoring just seven points on 2-for-9 shooting. He dished out just five assists and had the worst net rating of any of the team’s starters. It’s been a theme this season that he hasn’t been very efficient, and yet has logged heavy minutes. It didn't help tonight that Tyrese Proctor was a -16 and Mario Hezonja went scoreless.
--> Trying to find anything James Harden did correctly against the Knicks was a challenge. He wasn’t making shots, scoring just seven points on 2-for-9 shooting. He dished out just five assists and had the worst net rating of any of the team’s starters. It’s been a theme this season that he hasn’t been very efficient, and yet has logged heavy minutes. It didn't help tonight that Tyrese Proctor was a -16 and Mario Hezonja went scoreless.
 With Sam Merrill and Jaylon Tyson both out, there hasn’t been much left to fill the minutes void. Riley Minix, who inked a two-way contract right before the game in place of Tristan Enaruna, got 10 minutes. He even managed to knock in a few triples. Donovan Mitchell logged 37 minutes, which is above what he normally does.
--> With Sam Merrill and Jaylon Tyson both out, there hasn’t been much left to fill the minutes void. Riley Minix, who inked a two-way contract right before the game in place of Tristan Enaruna, got 10 minutes. He even managed to knock in a few triples. Donovan Mitchell logged 37 minutes, which is above what he normally does.
 Harden had another day to forget amidst a career-worst season. It was nice of him to take the discount and help get Peyton Watson in the door, but Kenny Atkinson has to consider benching him or cutting off opportunities.
--> Harden had another day to forget amidst a career-worst season. It was nice of him to take the discount and help get Peyton Watson in the door, but Kenny Atkinson has to consider benching him or cutting off opportunities.
 Part of the Atkinson issue has been failing to make these changes. If it’s not working, it’s not working. A spade is a spade.
--> Part of the Atkinson issue has been failing to make these changes. If it’s not working, it’s not working. A spade is a spade.
 2) Donovan Mitchell: Came To Play
--> 2) Donovan Mitchell: Came To Play
 It was only Donovan Mitchell for the Cavs who seemed to want it this evening. He was scoring at will all fourth quarter long, showing shades of the player he’s been in the past. Jarrett Allen wasn’t out there, so they were a bit undersized and were dominated on the glass.  
--> It was only Donovan Mitchell for the Cavs who seemed to want it this evening. He was scoring at will all fourth quarter long, showing shades of the player he’s been in the past. Jarrett Allen wasn’t out there, so they were a bit undersized and were dominated on the glass.  
 Mitchell got to his spots, but didn’t have a running mate, and it cost this team dearly. The injury report has continued to grow, and even the return of Peyton Watson couldn’t give them the lift they needed.
--> Mitchell got to his spots, but didn’t have a running mate, and it cost this team dearly. The injury report has continued to grow, and even the return of Peyton Watson couldn’t give them the lift they needed.
 37 points on 13-22 FG was great to see from Mitchell, but nobody else was able to get going. Putting up only 97 points will not lift this team past anybody, and a 5-5 record is their new predicament.

 Back On Monday
